title: KHR_character glTF Document Extension
description: Provides one author-selected character designation for a glTF asset and identifies its root node.

rootNode.description: Index of the glTF node designated as the character root.
rootNode.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `nodes` array. It does not assert scene membership, skin ownership, skeleton membership, or that every character-related node is its descendant.
